lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-linear grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the circular blobs, creating a series of anchor points that define a rectilinear pattern on the lateral skin surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from a high-intensity light edge above to a lower-intensity shadow region below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A moderate density of distinct, high-luminance circular spots is visible across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration observed towards the anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The primary pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, uniformly distributed high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank patterning.
